baseline_description: Preserved batch-aligned dirty-main production snapshot on 7c1fc09; prior validated binary copied unchanged (not a newly rebuilt exact-commit baseline).

fresh_hierarchy_attribution.method: Sum FEREG_CMG_HIERARCHY hierarchy_seconds across four ordinary frames, then median of five timed fits; untimed first fit excluded.
fresh_hierarchy_attribution.interpretation: Hierarchy cost depends on current weights and is not universally below five percent. This is not executor-construction time or evidence for a shared-executor API change. Every hierarchy remains fresh.

policy.scope: PPML ordinary-frame nuisance-basis solves only; OLS and response/control PCG remain cold
policy.hessian_weight_rule: Maximum bidirectional ratio of current/prior normalized weights <= 2; all guesses finite
policy.prior_frame: Complete per-RHS and combined certificates; no tighter retry or extra PCG restart
policy.feedback: For a seeded solve, maximum fresh initial residual / current RHS norm < 0.5 before retaining the next seed
policy.invalidation: Consume on assembly; reset on invalid input, failure, retry, active-basis replacement, and committed strict checkpoint
policy.memory: One extra core-vertices x nuisance f64 basis, plus preflighted metadata; 614400 basis bytes for the 1200-vertex/64-column cells
policy.authority: Fresh numeric graph, hierarchy, RHSs, current residual checks, Schur factor, and every independent PPML certificate remain mandatory

validation.workspace_oracles_and_integrations: All passed; individual suites and counts retained in rust.log
validation.ffi_initial_parallel_run: 85 passed / 4 failed: isolated allocation subprocesses inherited a sibling test's FEREG_PPML_PREFLIGHT_RECEIPT without its memory limit. Serialized rerun passed all 89; no test or production relaxation.
validation.profile_note: The v3 local science/smoke gates run through the live v4 manifest. Science timing was not used for performance promotion and overlapped the structural test tail.

changes_from_v5: fe/cmg.rs production token and literal counts/digests
guard_review.full_f0_and_scc: Not run; development-only acceptance remains open

notes: Local macOS diagnostics only. Exact binary/source hashes distinguish the prototype, final candidate, preserved baseline, and instrumented-cold counterfactual.
Ordinary public iteration counts remain the sum of per-frame maximum-RHS iterations. New summed nuisance counts do not replace those units.

The cold-work counterfactual is the final implementation with seed submission disabled in a detached temporary worktree. Use it for exact PCG counts and subphase attribution, not as the preserved timing baseline. No dormant switch is retained in production.
64-column seven-thread fine-graph nuisance PCG matvecs: K=0 4795 -> 3898; K=50 3765 -> 2963, including each seeded initial residual product.
No numerical fallback in the measured candidate CMG cells. Existing difficult-chain selective retries and canonical checkpoint retries remain visible and unchanged.

Easy zero-nuisance K=50 initial envelope medians were 1.081/1.119 seconds; the nine-repetition candidate-first confirmation was 1.055/1.074 (+1.8%). Exact-nested 8-column K=50 confirmation was 1.079/1.080 (+0.1%). Reported as small diagnostic timing differences, not exact parity or qualification.
Primary retained 64-column seven-thread medians: K=0 0.840 -> 0.679; K=50 1.657 -> 1.518. One-thread and fourteen-thread checks also improved.
No SCC, full F0 qualification, auto calibration, branch creation, upstream mutation, push, tag, or release.
